The Hyprland companion tools and desktop portals Omarchy's session depends on, layered over the compositor itself.
omarchy-hyprland deliberately does NOT install Hyprland: pod-hyprland already
owns the compositor, Xwayland and the nested session that runs it, and
declaring them twice would put the same behaviour in two places. What this
candy adds is the surrounding set Omarchy's own configuration and keybindings
invoke — the colour picker, the night-light daemon, the GUI dialogs, the
screen-share picker — plus the xdg-desktop-portal backends without which
screen sharing and file dialogs silently fail inside a Hyprland session.
Verifiable on the built image: every tool is on PATH and the Hyprland portal
backend is installed.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | the Hyprland companion tools Omarchy's bindings invoke are installed |
| `check` | the Hyprland portal backend that serves screencast and screenshot is installed |
| `check` | the GTK portal backend that serves file chooser and settings is installed |
| `check` | the Qt6 Wayland platform plugin the shell and GUI utilities need is installed |
| `check` | the compositor this candy layers over is present, but is NOT owned here |
